pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, angular patches with sharp, jagged edge gradients. Patches exhibit larger spatial area on the upper flank and torso, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometries on the neck and lower posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored corridors forming a topological graph with predominantly Y-shaped junction nodes. Corridor thickness remains relatively uniform across the central flank, narrowing slightly toward the dorsal ridge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous, low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette of the mane visible along the upper neck and spanning toward the shoulder ridge.
